title: The global search PR queried MailAccount and MailRule with plain .objects.filter() behind only a model-level has_perm check, unlike the owner-aware get_objects_for_user_owner_aware() it used for tags and correspondents, so users see other users' mail accounts and rules.

findings.explanation: All database access uses Django ORM methods (.select_related, .prefetch_related, .get, .filter) with parameter binding; no raw SQL or string interpolation is present.

The GlobalSearchView checks user permissions before querying each model (has_perm checks) and uses get_objects_for_user_owner_aware to enforce object‑level access. SavedView results are also limited to the requesting user. No object is returned without an ownership or permission check.
